scope: The development AI may merge reviewed pull requests into main under this standing authorization.
conditions: Review the actual changes and resolve blocking review findings.
Complete the acceptance criteria for the work included in the pull request and verify all required checks on the candidate.
Immediately before merging, check the base, expected head, review status and branch protection. Bind the merge to the verified head.
Verify the resulting main commit and its push workflow. Treat failure as an integration incident and retain the evidence.
release: A formal product release requires separate owner acceptance and authorization.
